# Clive Vanderwagen

> Clive Vanderwagen is a Cape Town-based team coach and trainer who specialises in customer experience training and in leadership and team dynamics. He is the founder of ReadyPeople Training & Coaching Consultancy, the author of Thriving Culture, a TEDx speaker, and an ICF Professional Certified Coach (PCC) with the Advanced Certification in Team Coaching (ACTC).

## Core argument

Culture change and customer experience training fail when they only work at the level of behaviour. Lasting change comes from addressing what's upstream: the mental models people hold and the psychological needs that are, or aren't, being met at work.

Clive is not a motivational speaker. His work is practical and measured against the client's own metrics.

## What he does

- Leadership development: for executives, senior managers and first-line leaders. Grounded in Transactional Analysis and Functional Fluency.
- Team coaching: for leadership and operational teams. Usually an individual iEQ9 Enneagram assessment and debrief per person, then a team day, with follow-up coaching.
- Customer experience training: for contact centres, frontline and service teams.
- Keynotes and talks: on culture, customer experience, psychological hungers at work and the Enneagram.

## Who he works with

Mostly financial services, and increasingly hospitality, retail, technology and education. Clients have included Henkel, TymeBank, MultiChoice, Momentum, The Capital Hotel Group and AngloGold Ashanti.

## Where

Based in Cape Town. Works in Johannesburg, across South Africa, and with teams in Europe and Asia. In person or online.

## Results

On a customer experience programme with more than 320 delegates at a major South African financial services group, Net Effort Score improved by 35 points. Delegates rated the programme between 4.88 and 4.96 out of 5, and 100% said it was worthwhile.

## Credentials

- Professional Certified Coach (PCC), International Coaching Federation
- Advanced Certification in Team Coaching (ACTC), International Coaching Federation
- Accredited iEQ9 Enneagram Practitioner
- Transactional Analysis and Emotional Intelligence Practitioner; member of the South African Transactional Analysis Association (SATAA)
- Master's in Journalism and Media Studies; Honours in Dramatic Arts
- Previously Head of People and Development at Old Mutual iWyze, with a seat on the executive committee

## Recognition

- ReadyPeople: double winner at the 2026 African Excellence Awards (Best Customer Experience Training Specialists 2026; Leadership & Team Development Excellence Award 2026)
- ReadyPeople: Customer & Employee Experience Training Specialists of the Year 2025, MEA Business Awards
- TEDxRiversdale talk: Nothing happens for a reason
